If you’re looking for a groomer who truly cares about your pet, I can’t recommend Vanessa enough. My corgi, Pollo, is a very anxious little guy, and Vanessa has always been incredibly patient and gentle with him. She is the only groomer I trust because she treats my pup as if he were her own.

Vanessa consistently gives Pollo phenomenal haircuts, and he always comes home unbelievably soft and smelling amazing. Her attention to detail is outstanding, and it’s clear how much pride she takes in her work. Knowing that Pollo is in such caring and capable hands gives me complete peace of mind. We’re so grateful to have found her!

I had a grooming appointment last week, and after my experience, I would NOT recommend the Lincoln Pet Supplies Plus for grooming to anyone. When I scheduled my appointment on the app, it showed that the price of this grooming would be $44. I called to confirm my appointment as well and spoke to a person from the Lincoln location. When I get there for the grooming appointment, they told me that the price is not reflected correctly online and that it is $59 instead of $44. Because of how much of a jump 44 to 59 is, I asked if the original price could be honored given that I was not made aware of this, EVEN WHEN I CALLED.

The woman let me know that I could get 15% off my grooming. I agreed and then the concerns kept coming. The woman who was grooming when we arrived was being very stern with the dog she was with, telling the dog that it was fine when he would pull his paw back or would pull harshly on the leash the dog had on when the dog would try to move on the table. It made me think that if they are comfortable speaking and moving the dogs like this in front of customers, what are they doing when they bring them to the crates or bring them to the back? It is a safety issue and I would not trust either woman that was there with my dog.

My dog can be reactive with some dogs, and be okay with others. This was very well known to the other grooming place I’ve gone to (Pet Supplies Plus on Dempster — LOVE them and Jake is amazing with our dog) and she always came out with great notes from the groomer on Dempster. When the groomer called to tell me she was done, she let me know that blow drying was hard and that she was being reactive to other dogs. I know my dog is strong and that she can be reactive to some dogs, however the way that they were treating the other dogs and the tone of voice and language they were using was not acceptable. It got to the point where when I got there to pick up my dog, the groomer said “No!”to her when she began to bark.

The groomer, Vanessa, let me know at pick up that they do not take reactive dogs because of liability. She explained that if it was a little bit of barking, it would be okay but because my dog was barking and lunging, she had to put a note on her account. Once again, I know my dog and that is why I also prefaced this reactivity prior to dropping her off, however my point still stands about the treatment towards the dogs in general. It is difficult to trust that this groomer tried her to best to handle my dog appropriately given that they were handling other non-reactive dogs inappropriately.

Going to stick to Jake at Pet Supplies Plus on Dempster!! But this had to be noted.

I get both of my Yorkies groomed but Vanessa. She always does Amazing job! She takes her time and does exactly what I asked for when it comes to the haircuts. If you’re looking for a dog groomer I highly recommend Vanessa at Pet Supplies plus on Lincoln.

Everyone at this store is so nice and super helpful. I have to go here more frequently for food for my finicky senior dogs. The parking lot is a mess (shares it with Trader Joe's), but go early or late - not in middle of day - it's much better.

I’ve been bringing my pup to PSP for grooming since she was little, and I wouldn’t go anywhere else. My long-haired corgi, Maggie, needs some extra attention—especially when it comes to her signature Corgi booty—and Vanessa always delivers! She’s a truly skilled groomer who consistently gives Maggie the perfect cut. Our pup always comes home happy, silky soft, and looking her best. A+ service every time!

I have had the most wonderful experiences with Savannah.  She is kind, compassionate and very loving with  my puppy Charley. He loves her!
Savannah listens closely to what I would like to have done and explains everything she will be doing in detail. She will advise me if my expectations are not always realistic and she has to do something different. I love her honesty and expertise. Charley always looks perfect when she finishes. She always exceeds my expectations!

At PetPlus at Lincoln Avenue managers are very friendly and customer service oriented. I had a same day delivery that Door dash just left in front of my building and the litter box was ripped on the side and as I took it down my stairs thinking it would be okay it spilled on my stairs! I called Pet Plus and talked to Ruby the manager on duty. She discussed it with the other manager and they sent me another one. I was very pleased by their promptness of the second litter and their concern to keep customers happy.  Thank you PetPlus, once again you prove to me you are the best! I been a customer for many years, this is the reason why!
Great location. One of the workers helped me find what I needed which were a few items. Ear cleaner and cone. I also bought 2 dog treats.

In my opinion, this is the friendliest and most understanding pet supply store in the entire north side of Chicago.

I have a beautiful 5 year old German Shepherd that Petco and Petsmarts all throughout the Chicagoland area were refusing to groom due to a couple minor soars on his paw caused by a health condition.

The pushback to help my Shepherd was absolutely perplexing.  I believe the real reason is the staff were somewhat intimidated about dealing with working line shepherds.

Petco and Petsmarts have lost my business forever.

I made an appointment with Lilly who is a groomer at this establishment and she went above and beyond to deliver excellent service!  My GSD’s nails were done quickly and perfectly.  They also have a self service dog wash that Petco and Petsmart locations do not have.

Lilly is extremely knowledgeable about all breeds and I highly recommend to come here and request for her if you need your dog groomed.
